_comment: Generated by scripts/build-notional-baseline.mjs — do not edit by hand. Prior result for the 2026 boundaries, rebuilt from 2023 in-seat voting place results located by coordinates. Shares are of votes cast at places standing inside the seat; advance votes cast elsewhere are excluded because they cannot be geolocated. A seat that kept its name and gained no located votes takes the source cycle's result for that name instead (`method: same-name`) — resolved through the rename table, so a renamed seat keeps its own result rather than being rebuilt from geometry. Seat rolls are scaled so they sum to the source cycle's `total_electors`. Boundary data: Stats NZ (CC BY 4.0).
